_comment: Terrain decides whether hiding works. This is the coupling that makes location choice and posture choice one decision instead of two.

terrains.label: Open Ground
terrains.description: Ridge lines, clearcuts, gravel pits. You can see and be seen. You cannot hide here — if anyone else shows up, there is a fight whatever you intended.

terrains.label: Mixed Cover
terrains.description: Trail, second growth, old roads. A fight happens only if somebody came hunting.

terrains.label: Deep Cover
terrains.description: Blowdown, fog bog, old growth. Hiding always works here. Nobody finds anybody — and a hunter who comes looking finds nothing and makes noise.
